HediffDef.label: tin savant
HediffDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} has burned tin so extensively that it has become woven into {PAWN_possessive} spirit web. {PAWN_possessive} senses are permanently heightened, but {PAWN_pronoun} suffers without the metal's influence.

HediffDef.label: pewter savant
HediffDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} has burned pewter for so long that {PAWN_possessive} body has grown dependent on its strength. Without it, {PAWN_possessive} muscles feel like wet cloth and {PAWN_possessive} bones ache under their own weight.

HediffDef.label: brass savant
HediffDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} has Soothed so many emotions that {PAWN_pronoun} can no longer distinguish {PAWN_possessive} own feelings from those {PAWN_pronoun} suppresses in others. The boundaries of self have blurred.

HediffDef.label: zinc savant
HediffDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} has Rioted emotions so frequently that {PAWN_possessive} own emotional responses have dulled. {PAWN_pronoun} feels the passions of others more vividly than {PAWN_possessive} own.

HediffDef.label: copper savant
HediffDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} has maintained a coppercloud for so long that {PAWN_possessive} mind has become a fortress of silence. Without copper burning, {PAWN_possessive} thoughts scatter like ash in the wind.

HediffDef.label: bronze savant
HediffDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} has Sought Allomantic pulses so relentlessly that {PAWN_pronoun} can now detect them even through copperclouds. The rhythms of burning metal have become a constant hum in {PAWN_possessive} awareness.

HediffDef.label: steel savant
HediffDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} has Pushed on metal so extensively that faint blue lines flicker at the edges of {PAWN_possessive} vision even when not burning steel. Every piece of metal whispers its position.

HediffDef.label: iron savant
HediffDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} has Pulled on metal so often that {PAWN_pronoun} instinctively senses nearby metal even without burning iron. The weight and position of every metallic object registers in {PAWN_possessive} mind.

HediffDef.label: gold savant
HediffDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} has burned gold so deeply that glimpses of past selves bleed through unbidden. Shadows of who {PAWN_pronoun} might have been linger at the corners of {PAWN_possessive} perception.

HediffDef.label: electrum savant
HediffDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} has burned electrum until branching futures have become visible without conscious effort. Possible selves flicker ahead of {PAWN_objectPronoun}, each one a path not yet taken.

HediffDef.label: atium savant
HediffDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} has burned atium so recklessly that temporal awareness has scarred {PAWN_possessive} spirit web. {PAWN_pronoun} perceives combat with an unnatural prescience, but each use exacts a toll on {PAWN_possessive} body.

HediffDef.label: cadmium savant
HediffDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} has slowed time around {PAWN_objectPronoun}self so frequently that {PAWN_possessive} perception of time's passage has permanently shifted. Moments stretch and compress without warning.

HediffDef.label: bendalloy savant
HediffDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} has accelerated time so often that {PAWN_pronoun} exists in a state of perpetual urgency. The world outside {PAWN_possessive} speed bubble feels unbearably slow.

HediffDef.label: aluminum savant
HediffDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} has burned aluminum so thoroughly that {PAWN_possessive} spirit web has been smoothed and scoured. Internal Allomantic reserves drain faster, as if the metal itself remembers its purpose.

HediffDef.label: duralumin savant
HediffDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} has channeled duralumin surges so many times that {PAWN_possessive} spirit web craves amplification. Burning any metal without duralumin feels muted and insufficient.

HediffDef.label: chromium savant
HediffDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} has leeched Allomantic reserves so extensively that {PAWN_possessive} touch passively dampens Investiture in those nearby. Other Allomancers sense an unsettling void around {PAWN_objectPronoun}.

HediffDef.label: nicrosil savant
HediffDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} has amplified others' Allomantic abilities so frequently that {PAWN_possessive} touch passively boosts the Investiture of allies. Other Allomancers burn brighter in {PAWN_possessive} presence.
